LanguageData.LP_DivineBlood.label: awakened divine blood
LanguageData.LP_DivineBlood.description: When the Gate of the Heavens opened, the divine father's divinity flowed into the titan's blood: psychic sensitivity +20%, and another ring of faint golden divine glow above the head. Body size unchanged (2.5× like a titan). This divine blood is not passed on to descendants.
